code: case "lollipop":       drawLollipop(g, data, enc, scales, style, w, h, interact, theme, markRegistry);       break; // A stem from zero to each value, with a dot at the end. Each lollipop is // one <g>, so tooltips, hover, brushing and selection all act on the stem // and the dot together. function drawLollipop(g, data, enc, scales, style, w, h, interact, theme, markRegistry) {   const baseOpacity = style.opacity ?? 0.9;   const r = style.size || 5;   const slotWidth = groupSlotWidth(scales, enc, 40);   const px = d => xPos(scales, enc, d, slotWidth);   const py = d => yPos(scales, enc, d);   // Stems start at zero, or at the edge of the plot when a domain set with   // scale() leaves zero outside it.   const base = scales.y ? Math.max(0, Math.min(h, scales.y(0))) : h;   const colour = d => scales.color ? scales.color(getVal(d, enc.color)) : (theme.accent || "#4269d0");    const pops = g.append("g").attr("class", "marks-lollipop")     .selectAll("g")     .data(data)     .join("g")     .attr("class", "glyph-lollipop")     .attr("opacity", baseOpacity);   pops.append("line")     .attr("x1", px).attr("x2", px)     .attr("y1", base).attr("y2", py)     .attr("stroke", colour)     .attr("stroke-width", style.stroke_width || 1.5);   pops.append("circle")     .attr("cx", px).attr("cy", py)     .attr("r", r)     .attr("fill", colour);    // Brushing selects a lollipop when its dot is inside the brushed area.   const finder = pointFinder(pops, px, py);   registerMark(markRegistry, pops, baseOpacity, {     brush: {       rowLevel: true,       nearest: (mx, my, tolerance) => finder.nearest(mx, my, tolerance),       hit: (d, i, node, [[x0, y0], [x1, y1]]) => {         const x = px(d), y = py(d);         return x >= x0 && x <= x1 && y >= y0 && y <= y1;       },       opacity: hit => hit ? 1 : 0.15     }   });    if (interact.tooltip?.enabled) addTooltip(pops, data, enc, interact.tooltip, theme);   if (interact.hover?.enabled) {     pops       .on("mouseover.hover", function() { d3.select(this).select("circle").attr("r", r * 1.6); })       .on("mouseout.hover", function() { d3.select(this).select("circle").attr("r", r); });   }   if (interact.click?.enabled) addClickSelect(pops, interact.click.action, baseOpacity, markRegistry); }
